name: readable-contract-fields
goal: Each contract field appears once with its recorded description; missing descriptions remain explicit.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Fresh candidate overview repeated each described field name. Show each once, retaining every field of partially described contracts.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Two existing component/contract tests failed on duplicate labels and the missing undescribed tab field before repair; 16 other tests passed.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Grouped fields render once with explicit missing descriptions; scoped block layout prevents the native host grid from squeezing nested values.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Nineteen contract tests and thirteen shared browser checks pass, including the unchanged raw-array admission guard and six desktop/tablet/mobile layout regressions.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports check passed 553 tests; 19 contract, 16 wiring/import, and 13 browser checks passed. Desktop/tablet/mobile captures were inspected; root format, types, lint, audit and registry passed. Independent review found no blocking issues.
